fields.name: EvaluationOverview
fields.fieldText:
Evaluation Overview & Details

Instructions: Please review and edit the information below as necessary and then click 'Next'. If an evaluation needs to be deleted, please submit a Help Desk Ticket.

Participant: {!varParticipantName}
Evaluation Competency Average: {!varCompetencyAverage}

fields.name: TimeManagement
fields.fieldText:
Time Management
#1 Constructively Busy: Stays constructively busy from the beginning to the end of scheduled work time. #2 Stays on Schedule: Tasks and/or route completed in the required timeframe. Follows break schedule. #3 Meet Standards in Timely Manner: Assigned route/work area is serviced to CLSL standards in a timely manner, including debris, snow, grass, sign removal, etc.

fields.name: Communication
fields.fieldText:
Communication
#4 Positive Attitude: Consistently demonstrates a positive attitude, including body language, facial expressions, and verbal response. #5 Information Sharing: Provides factual information about CLSL, CLSL partners and recycling. Takes every opportunity to greet and actively encourage residents to recycle. #6 Understands Work: Has full understanding of routes and/or instruction before starting a task. Asks questions for clarity. #7 Professional Communication: Professional tone and direct eye contact. Makes proper introduction: “Hello my name is ______. Your name is_____? Closes with a ‘thank you’ and a handshake. #8 Customer Service Pitch: Knows the written customer service pitch and the constituents.

fields.name: Professionalism
fields.fieldText:
Professionalism
#9 Preparedness: Uniform meets standards by having all articles of uniform and is neat and clean (boots) shined (and is prepared for roll call with topic and song). #10 Proper Equipment Handling: Equipment is properly handled and used for the appropriate task. #11 Follows Safety Procedures: Follows and adheres to all safety procedures and takes necessary precautions while at worksite. #12 Completes Tasks as Directed: Completes work as directed by supervisor or work order.

fields.name: ConflictResolution
fields.fieldText:
Conflict Resolution
#13 Follows Protocol: Uses proper protocol for any challenges, questions, or comments. #14 Accepts Coaching & Criticism: Accepts coaching & constructive criticism in a positive and professional manner. #15 Conflict Management: Utilizes the three basics of conflict management (pause, listen, and create a solution). Resolves conflict and accepts constructive criticism in a positive and professional manner.

fields.name: Teamwork
fields.fieldText:
Teamwork
#16 Energy & Motivation: Shows energetic and extraordinary motivation throughout the workday. #17 Goes Above and Beyond: Performs additional tasks/chores before or after each workday and approved by supervisor. #18 Assists Others: Takes advantage of any opportunity to assist another FSR complete a task. Participates in loading and unloading of vehicles on routes or at the work site.
